content.comment_body: Edit: Issue resolved. The information found in the referenced FAQ provided the necessary solution. Updating the [product_name] software was required and worked well. Firstly, in [product_name] I attempted to use 'save-as' -> binary and save the file to an SD card (formatted FAT32, 16GB) with the default binary filename. After inserting the card into the device and requesting a program save, the device reset itself but the program did not transfer. Next, I tried using an Ethernet cable. Set up device IP: 192.168.0.3, mask: 255.255.255.0, gateway: 192.168.0.1. On the PC, IP was set to 192.168.0.5, mask 255.255.255.0, gateway: 192.168.0.1. [product_name] showed successful connection and detected the device. When transferring the program, the transfer window closed almost immediately with no error messages, but the program did not appear on the device. Device model is new [article_no].
Please refer to this FAQ: Why is downloading programs to your new [product_name] [version_no] unsuccessful?
A new question from [user_name] has been moved to a new thread titled 'Having trouble loading a program from an SD card to the [product_name]'. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The main user challenge involved unsuccessful program transfers to the [product_name] device via both SD card and Ethernet methods. The SD card method triggered a device reset but failed to transfer the program, while the Ethernet method closed the transfer window without any errors or successful program loading. The problem was resolved after updating the [product_name] software, as suggested by information in the FAQ, indicating that outdated software may have caused compatibility or functionality issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a straightforward and dependable process for transferring programs to the [product_name] device via SD card or Ethernet, with clear feedback or error messages when problems arise.
